Native and enlarged pixels reviewed. Automated checks supplement these observations.

limitations: No new disconnected, duplicated, recolored or clipped limb was observed in the reviewed evidence. This is an observation bounded by the recorded scope, not a claim about untested future changes.
Two unrelated pre-existing contact/balance tests still fail identically to the prior baseline.
Original PNG provenance reaches the earliest available upload; hidden backing reconstruction is preserved from PR68.
Ragdoll retains existing whole-body motion rather than independent shoulder roll.

checks: Source: 12 live creatures including evolved crab, drake and stag, both-team stride updates at 50/150/100%, animated combat, reset and phone layouts
Offline: 12 live creatures including evolved crab, drake and stag, both-team stride updates at 50/150/100%, animated combat, reset and phone layouts, zero external dependencies
Opening scene shows eight views side by side; all nine characters have eight distinct sprites at one fixed pose phase, with native 64×64 cells; clicking a view opens its close inspection
Randomized teams have six creatures each; cards match the lineup, and pause/frame stepping preserve simulation control
Selecting a character and clicking ground produces actual movement in the physical scene
All nine locomotion profiles travel around the circuits and turn through all eight facings; speed changes work
Walk/run/sprint pace controls, selected sprint toggle, Shift hold/release, acceleration, stride blending and stamina recovery work
Eight directional views and seventeen animation states are inspectable, including a close view and death
Restart changes the actual team composition; charged-strike control survives impact while taking damage, with visible anticipation levels
Rendered sparring resolves with physical hits, projectile travel, rolls and deaths; optional audio toggles
390px mobile layout has no horizontal overflow and retains scene and character controls
Standalone HTML runs combat and pose inspection with zero external requests
